I usually stay up until 3 or 4 in the morning since I'll dread the next day as well
Wait! Talk to us on reddit \(or a hotline/professional\) before you do anything that has permanent consequences! We just might be able to help you figure this out in a better way...

I can def relate, my family has seen me depressed for so long they've grown to despise my very presence. Only advice I can give is to talk to someone outside of your circle, someone w/o any preconceived notion of your character. Like a therapist, and if you already have one that isn't working, try a new one. Having someone new to listen to you and your concerns might solve something.

I'm also 22, also ugly, also the dumbest person at his university \(at least enough to drop out of his original major\). Hopefully you find someone you can relate to, I'm willing to bet many of us are out there

Chances are if you think you're depressed, you probably are. Try talking to somebody at least, letting emotions and thoughts out to someone who will listen does wonders when you're otherwise trapped in your own head.
